summary: Join our Effective Stakeholder Engagement in Governance course to master techniques for engaging stakeholders and improving governance outcomes.
lede: Effective stakeholder engagement in governance helps professionals identify the people who matter most, understand their interests and influence, and involve them at the right time. This practical course shows how structured engagement can build trust, manage expectations, reduce resistance, and strengthen governance decisions. Participants learn to map stakeholders, design engagement strategies, manage difficult conversations, and respond to resistance. They also learn how to turn feedback and dialogue into clear decisions and action while communicating choices with honesty.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly engage or are expected to engage stakeholders in governance processes.
audience: Officials in ministries, departments, and agencies
modules: Foundations of Stakeholder Engagement in Governance
Designing Stakeholder Engagement Strategies and Plans
Communication Skills for Dialogue and Consultation
Managing Conflict, Resistance, and Difficult Stakeholders
Inclusion, Equity, and Engaging Vulnerable Groups
Participatory Policy, Budget, and Service Delivery Processes
Working with Media and Digital Platforms for Engagement
Monitoring, Learning, and Documenting Stakeholder Engagement
Action Planning and Applying Learning to Your Governance Context
prerequisites: Participants should have foundational knowledge of governance processes and experience in stakeholder interactions. A willingness to engage in role-play and group activities is essential.
